def diff_core(before, after):

    ch = [(r,c,b[r][c],a[r][c]) for r in range(len(a)) for c in range(len(a[r])) if b[r][c]!=a[r][c]]

probes = [ (50,30,'right-grid white N'), (55,30,'right-grid center'), (52,12,'left-grid gray corner'),

def diff_core(before, after):
    b = before.ascii.split('\n'); a = after.ascii.split('\n')
